title: Add Author Section to README.md
description: Update the root README.md file to include an 'Author' section attributing the project to 'RafiulM'.
details: Open the README.md file located in the root directory of the repository. Add a new section titled '## Author' or '## Credits' at a logical location (preferably at the end of the file or after the main description). Under this heading, add the line: 'Created by [RafiulM](https://github.com/RafiulM)'. Ensure proper Markdown formatting and that the link is correct.
test_strategy: Preview the updated README.md file in a Markdown viewer or on the repository platform (e.g., GitHub) to verify that the 'Author' section appears correctly and the link to the author's profile works as intended.
